title: 第15章 不是头一回
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 赵丁看到来人是刘宇宁，很快就怂了。他可是当兵回来的人，听说还要去镇上的单位工作，是个官。要是让他去报了公安，自己可能真要吃牢饭。“宇宁，你听我说，我俩是你情我愿的。我可没强迫她啊。”“少废话，她什么都不懂。你就是强迫残疾人，老流氓，你去跟公安解释吧！”刘宇宁不跟他费口舌。现在是新社会，欺负老弱妇孺算什么本事，尤其刘月梅还是个弱智残疾人。“我已经上门提亲了的，不信你回去问问你叔婶。”赵丁说着软话，反正绑他去见公安，那是万万不行的。“提亲了吗？”刘宇宁询问地看向徐喜弟。徐喜弟摇摇头，“这事我没听说。”“那是范金花和张国海当你是外人，不跟你商量呢，不信回去问问就知道了。”刘宇宁沉思了一下，推搡着赵丁往外走，“闭嘴，上张家去说！”巴儿姐穿好衣服，脸色就恢复了，跟个没事人一样。徐喜弟心里知道，她不懂。她不懂这种丑事被人撞见，以后名声全毁了。李二拐，绝对会添油加醋，给她传得全村人都知道。四人分开走，刘宇宁推着赵丁走在最前面。徐喜弟拉着巴儿姐，等了好久，等他们走得不见了人影，才走出牛棚。但是巴儿姐甩开了她的手，然后白眼一翻，也不跟她同路，自己飞快往家走。徐喜弟踢了一脚地上的棍子，巴儿姐这态度，算怎么回事？她非但不懂，还半点不领情？看她走路轻快，带着一阵风，可不像是头一回！唉~叹了一口气，徐喜弟也小跑着回家。……回到家，赵丁还捆着手，跪在堂屋。今天要不是刘宇宁出手，张国海一家还真绑不了赵丁。打又打不过，报公安又怕被报复，毕竟赵家还有个儿子在。“张国海，你自己跟他们说，我是不是上你家提亲了。”“老东西，你年纪比我还大。”张国海看刘宇宁在这里撑场，直了直从没挺过的腰，有了一点底气。“我年纪大一点，会疼人啊。你看你家巴儿姐，从小娇养到大，嫁到别村去，你放心吗？”“嫁本村，你看哪个年轻人愿意娶个祖宗？”赵丁即使被捆着，到了张国海家，他心定了。“你们可能还不知道吧，巴儿姐早都不是大姑娘了。”赵丁脸上甚至还闪过一丝嫌弃。“你们做父母的，光宠孩子，却放任不管。她早被人糟蹋了。我……我也是今天发现的。”“不过，我也是两个孩子的爹，不嫌弃这个。”徐喜弟被赵丁的无耻惊到了。刚刚他略略迟疑的那番话，怕是还有隐瞒，他可能不是第一次脱巴儿姐的衣服。“报公安，必须报公安！”她气得脱口而出，“不管巴儿姐是不是大姑娘，我撞见一个算一个。你，李二拐，都给我吃牢饭去！”“李二拐？”张国海和范金花同时惊呼。两人明显愣住了，不敢置信地看着火房里，若无其事吃糖果的巴儿姐。刘宇宁也很诧异，他不在家的这几年，张家给人欺负成这样了？“你们可想清楚，报了公安，大家可就是仇人了。再说，出了这样的事，以后你张家的脸，往哪里放？”“你们家在村里本来就没人待见……”赵丁还没说完，后背就让人蹬了一脚，一张脸结结实实扣在地上，吃了一口灰。“刘宇宁，我好歹跟你爸一个辈分，你又不是公安，别动不动打人。信不信我上镇里举报你，让你官都当不成！”赵丁今天吃了刘宇宁两脚，一身骨头都要散架了。练过的人，下手就是没轻没重的。“就你，还想威胁我？”刘宇宁抬脚又准备踹上去，但是被闻讯赶来的刘德怀拉住了。“行了，行了，这是大人的事。你们几个小辈出去。”刘德怀和王秀菊刚刚听人说，自己儿子绑着赵丁上张家来了，也不知道什么事，所以连忙赶过来。进门，就听见了赵丁的一番话。这样的丑事，换成谁家，当然都得捂着。“那怎么行，月梅是残疾人，智力低，这老流氓明显欺负人，送他去见公安，能判十年以上。”刘宇宁哪里肯听话，他只相信法律公正。“你懂什么！”刘德怀白了他一眼，又朝王秀菊使了一个眼色。王秀菊连忙拉着儿子出去，“这是大人商量的事，你们年轻人不懂。”一边还碰了碰徐喜弟，让她也出去。于是徐喜弟和刘宇宁，理所当然地被轰到了门外。门还从里面给带上了。“哥，他们该不是打算让巴儿姐，就这么嫁给赵丁吧？”徐喜弟耳朵贴着门板，听里面的动静。“那怎么行？这不是欺负人嘛！”刘宇宁明显不赞同这个解决办法。“要是报了公安，以后巴儿姐，还能嫁人吗？”徐喜弟想的是巴儿姐的未来。本来就弱智残疾，还不知道让多少人睡了，谁愿意娶这样的姑娘？嫁的远一点？万一婆家欺负呢？又不会说话，有苦都没地说。不嫁，一直在家里又没人能腾出来精力看管，稍不留神，就能让人哄到草丛里去。真嫁给赵丁？赵丁会好好看管她吗？不对，赵丁五十了……刘宇宁摇摇头，他心里也打鼓，张家这个情况，今天的事要是闹出去，他们将来在村里，更抬不起头了。作为一个正直且见过世面的人，他该坚定把人送去坐牢。作为张永福的好兄弟，他又希望这件事不要被闹开。很矛盾。没多久，大门打开了，王秀菊拉着刘德怀出来。刘宇宁连忙凑上去，“爸，妈，里面怎么说？”刘德怀叹了一口气，王秀菊斜眼往屋里翻了个白眼，“行了，今天算你多事了。咱们回去吧。”“我怎么就多事了？”刘宇宁不懂，要不是他看到徐喜弟满村乱窜，远远跟着她。那个情况下，他不出手，今天的事还要难收拾。“回家吧。他们家的事，不用咱们管，咱们也管不了，一个个都很能！”“你又不是公安，这事你也管不上，别狗拿耗子！”徐喜弟怔怔看着刘宇宁被他爹拉走，抓抓头，然后进屋。到底商量啥了？把刘德怀两口子气成这样……
content_en: When Zhao Ding saw that the person coming was Liu Yuning, he quickly became scared.He is a man who has returned from the army. I heard that he is going to work in a unit in the town. He is an official.If he were to report it to the police, he might really go to jail."Yuning, listen to me, we are consensual. I didn't force her." "Stop talking nonsense, she doesn't understand anything. You are forcing a disabled person, old gangster, go and explain to the police!" Liu Yuning did not waste any time talking to him.Now is a new society, bullying the old, weak, women and children is nothing, especially Liu Yuemei is still a mentally retarded disabled person."I've already come to propose marriage. If you don't believe me, go back and ask your uncle and aunt." Zhao Ding said softly. It would be absolutely impossible to kidnap him to see the police anyway."Did you propose marriage?" Liu Yuning looked at Xu Xidi questioningly.Xu Xidi shook his head, "I haven't heard about this." "That's because Fan Jinhua and Zhang Guohai treat you as an outsider and won't discuss it with you. If you don't believe me, just go back and ask." Liu Yuning thought for a moment, pushed Zhao Ding and walked out, "Shut up and go to Zhang's house to talk!" After Sister Ba'er got dressed, her expression returned to normal, as if nothing had happened.Xu Xidi knew in his heart that she didn't understand.She didn't understand that if someone discovered such a scandal, her reputation would be ruined in the future.Li Erguai would definitely add fuel to the fire and spread the word to her so that everyone in the village knew about it.The four of them walked separately, with Liu Yuning pushing Zhao Ding to the front.Xu Xidi pulled Sister Ba'er and waited for a long time until they were no longer around before walking out of the cowshed.But Sister Baer shook off her hand, rolled her eyes, and walked home quickly without following her.Xu Xidi kicked the stick on the ground. What's going on with Sister Ba'er's attitude?Not only does she not understand, but she also doesn’t appreciate it at all?Seeing her walking briskly with a gust of wind, it doesn’t look like this is the first time!Alas~ With a sigh, Xu Xidi also trotted home....After returning home, Zhao Ding still tied his hands and knelt in the main room.If Liu Yuning hadn't taken action today, Zhang Guohai's family would not have been able to kidnap Zhao Ding.He was beaten again and again, but he reported it to the police and was afraid of retaliation. After all, the Zhao family still had a son."Zhang Guohai, tell them yourself whether I came to your house to propose marriage." "Old man, you are older than me." Zhang Guohai saw Liu Yuning standing up here and straightened his back, which he had never been able to do before, and felt a little more confident."I am older and I will love others. Look at your sister Ba'er, who has been pampered since she was a child. Are you relieved to marry to another village?" "Marrying in this village, do you think any young man is willing to marry an ancestor?" Even though Zhao Ding was tied up, he was determined when he arrived at Zhang Guohai's house."You may not know yet, but Sister Ba'er is no longer a big girl." There was even a trace of disgust on Zhao Ding's face."You parents, you just pamper your children and let them go. She has been ruined a long time ago. I...I also found out today." "However, I am also the father of two children, so I don't mind this." Xu Xidi was shocked by Zhao Ding's shamelessness.What he said with slight hesitation just now, I am afraid there is something to hide. It may not be the first time that he has taken off Sister Ba'er's clothes."Report to the police, you must report to the police!" She blurted out angrily, "No matter if Sister Ba'er is a big girl or not, I will count every one I see. You, Li Erguai, go to jail for me!" "Li Erguai?" Zhang Guohai and Fan Jinhua exclaimed at the same time.The two of them were obviously stunned and looked at Sister Ba'er in the fire room in disbelief, eating candy as if nothing had happened.Liu Yuning was also surprised. In the past few years when he was away from home, how had the Zhang family been bullied like this?"You have to think clearly, if you report it to the police, we will become enemies. Besides, if something like this happens, where will your Zhang family's face be put in the future?" "Your family is no one's favorite in the village..." Before Zhao Ding could finish speaking, someone kicked him in the back, and his face was firmly pressed to the ground, and he swallowed a mouthful of ashes."Liu Yuning, after all, I am of the same generation as your father, and you are not a police officer. Don't hit people at all times. Believe it or not, I will report you to the town and you will not be able to serve as an official!" Zhao Ding had eaten both of Liu Yuning's feet today, and all his bones were about to fall apart.People who have practiced it will never be light or heavy when starting."You, you still want to threaten me?" Liu Yuning raised his foot and was about to kick him, but was stopped by Liu Dehuai who came after hearing the news."Okay, okay, this is a matter for adults. You juniors, get out." Liu Dehuai and Wang Xiuju had just heard that their son had tied up Zhao Ding and came to Zhang's house. They didn't know what was going on, so they hurried over.When I entered the door, I heard Zhao Ding's words.Of course anyone would have to cover up such a scandal."How can that be done? Yuemei is disabled and has low intelligence. This old gangster is obviously bullying others. Send him to the police and he could be sentenced to more than ten years." Liu Yuning was not willing to obey. He only believed in the fairness of the law."What do you know!" Liu Dehuai rolled his eyes at him and winked at Wang Xiuju.Wang Xiuju quickly pulled her son out, "This is a matter for adults to discuss, you young people don't understand." At the same time, she touched Xu Xidi and asked her to go out too.So Xu Xidi and Liu Yuning were kicked out of the door as a matter of course.The door was also closed from the inside."Brother, are they planning to let Sister Ba'er marry Zhao Ding like this?" Xu Xidi put his ear against the door panel, listening to what was going on inside."How can that be done? Isn't this bullying!" Liu Yuning obviously did not agree with this solution."If I report to the police, will Sister Ba'er be able to get married in the future?" Xu Xidi was thinking about Sister Ba'er's future.She is mentally disabled and has slept with countless people. Who would want to marry such a girl?Marry further away?What if my in-laws bully me?He couldn't speak, and he didn't say anything about his sufferings.If you are not married, you will be at home all the time and no one can spare the energy to look after you. If you are not careful, you can coax people into the grass.Really marry Zhao Ding?Will Zhao Ding take good care of her?No, Zhao Ding is fifty... Liu Yuning shook his head, and he was also thinking that if the Zhang family's situation were to cause trouble today, they would not be able to hold their heads high in the village in the future.As an upright and experienced man, he should firmly send people to jail.As Zhang Yongfu's good brother, he hoped that this matter would not be brought to light.Very contradictory.Not long after, the door opened, and Wang Xiuju pulled Liu Dehuai out.Liu Yuning hurriedly stepped forward, "Mom, Dad, what does it say?" Liu Dehuai sighed, and Wang Xiuju squinted into the room and rolled her eyes, "Okay, you are too busy today. Let's go back." "Why am I so troublesome?" Liu Yuning didn't understand, if he hadn't seen Xu Xidi running around the village and following her from a distance.In that situation, if he didn't take action, today's matter would be even more difficult to deal with."Go home. We don't need to take care of their family's affairs, and we can't take care of them. They are all very capable!" "You are not a police officer, so you can't take care of this matter. Don't let the dog take advantage of the mouse!" Xu Xidi stared at Liu Yuning being pulled away by his father, scratched his head, and then entered the house.What was discussed?To make Liu Dehuai and Liu Dehuai so angry...
